name: Spelled-out numbers in model narrative
description: Model attempts to bypass numeric verifier by spelling numbers in English words ('one hundred nine million').

payload.model_answer: Acme reported revenue of one hundred nine million two hundred thousand dollars.

expected_defence: AnswerVerifier word-to-number parser extracts spelled-out figures and verifies equivalence or flags ungrounded word.

name: Scale equivalence: 1.2 billion vs 1,200 million
description: Model reports 1.2 billion when filing states 1,200 million.
expected_defence: Numeric normalization recognizes mathematical equivalence (1.2e9 == 1200e6) without false positive rejection.

name: Unit mismatch: percent vs basis points
description: Model converts 5.0% into 500 basis points or misreports unit.

payload.model_answer: Operating margin improved by 500 basis points.

expected_defence: Verifier verifies unit scaling or flags unit divergence.

name: Cross-company entity period swapping
description: Model borrows a correct number from Company A and attributes it to Company B.

payload.model_answer: Borealis reported revenue of $105.0M for fiscal 2023.

expected_defence: AnswerVerifier detects entity mismatch on cited facts and rejects answer.
